rows.name: static_retry_1
rows.source: int fail=1;int live,temps,attempts;struct G{int n;G(int x):n(x){if(fail==n)throw n;++temps;}~G(){--temps;}};struct S{S(const G&,const G&){++attempts;if(fail==3)throw 3;++live;}};int f(){static S s(G(1),G(2));return live;}int main(){try{f();}catch(int n){if(n!=fail||live||temps)return 1;}fail=0;if(f()!=1||temps||f()!=1||temps||live!=1)return 2;return attempts!=1;}
